hero.caption: 02 / Company
hero.lede: A 45-person engineering and delivery firm in Brazzaville, building national-scale technology for Central Africa.

story.title: From a small office, a national mandate.
paragraphs: Akieni was founded with a single conviction: that Central Africa's next decade depends on locally-built, internationally-credible digital infrastructure · and that the talent to build it is already here.

We have grown to a 45-person team across Engineering, Delivery, Administration and HR, and shipped into production three of the country's most critical platforms: SFEC for the Ministry of Finance, CAMU for universal health coverage, and CNSS for social security. Each was delivered to standards equal to anything you would find in Paris or Lagos · by a team that is 100% African, based on the banks of the Congo river.

hero.title: SFEC.
hero.lede: Système de Facturation Électronique Certifié · the national platform modernising tax collection, certified invoicing and real-time fiscal compliance in the Republic of Congo.

challenge.title: A 21st-century fiscal system, built from scratch.
paragraphs: Congo needed a national electronic fiscal system to modernise tax collection, ensure compliance, and track every commercial transaction in real time · without disrupting the millions of operations that ride on it daily.

The mandate was unforgiving: build the platform end-to-end (architecture, security, software, hardware integration), deploy it across all fiscal zones, and meet international standards for certified invoicing · in 24 months.

solution.title: SFEC, top to bottom.
solution.lede: We designed and built SFEC as a single, defensible platform · every layer engineered by the Akieni team, from PKI to UI.
items: PKI infrastructure with our own Certificate Authority
Compliance reporting and audit trails for DGID

stack.lede: Technology choices were made on operability and longevity · Go for the backend hot paths, Postgres for state, Kubernetes for orchestration, hardware-backed keys for the PKI.

impact.lede: Measured outcomes for the Ministry of Finance and, indirectly, every taxpayer and operator in the country.

cells.desc: National rollout across every fiscal zone in the country.
Live compliance monitoring of every certified transaction.
Material reductions in fraud and revenue leakage.

privacy.caption: 09 / LEGAL · LAST UPDATED MAY 2026
privacy.title: Privacy Policy.
privacy.lede: How Akieni collects, uses, and protects personal information across our website and engagements.

sections.heading: Who we are
sections.body: Akieni is a digital transformation firm registered in the Republic of Congo, with its main office in Brazzaville. We are the data controller for personal data collected through this website (akieni.com) and through the contracts we sign with our clients.

sections.heading: What we collect
sections.body: Through this site, we only collect what you give us. When you contact us, we store your name, email, organisation and message · nothing more. We log standard server diagnostics (anonymised IP, user agent, request path) for 30 days to defend against abuse and keep the site running. We do not use third-party analytics or advertising trackers.

sections.heading: How we use it
sections.body: We use the contact information you provide to respond to your enquiry and, if relevant, to follow up about the programme you described. We do not sell, rent, or share your personal information with third parties for marketing purposes. We do not enrol you in any mailing list without your explicit consent.

sections.heading: Lawful basis
sections.body: Our processing is based either on your consent (when you contact us), on the performance of a contract (when we work together), or on our legitimate interest in operating a secure website.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
sections.body: Contact enquiries are retained for up to 24 months after our last exchange, then deleted. Client data is governed by the relevant engagement contract, which always defines retention, ownership and disposal.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data at any time by writing to contact@akieni.com. We respond within 30 days. You may also lodge a complaint with the competent national authority.

sections.heading: Security
sections.body: We host our website and client systems on infrastructure with industry-standard security controls · TLS in transit, encryption at rest, access logging, least-privilege access. Production environments handling sensitive data sit behind dedicated identity and audit layers.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
sections.body: We will revise this page if our practices change. The 'Last updated' date at the top of this page indicates the current version.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: Questions about this policy, or about any personal data we hold, should be directed to contact@akieni.com.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy.
cookies.lede: Akieni uses cookies sparingly. This page describes which ones, why, and how to control them.

sections.heading: About cookies
sections.body: Cookies are small text files placed on your device by websites you visit. They are used to make sites work, remember preferences, or measure usage. This page explains how Akieni uses cookies on akieni.com.

sections.heading: What we use
sections.body: We use a single category of strictly necessary cookies · used to remember your cookie preferences and to maintain basic site functionality (for example, dismissing a banner). We do not use advertising cookies. We do not use third-party analytics cookies.

sections.heading: What we don't use
sections.body: We do not place tracking pixels from advertising networks. We do not load embedded social-media widgets that set their own cookies. We do not share browsing behaviour with third parties.

sections.heading: Your choices
sections.body: Because we only set strictly necessary cookies, no consent is required. You may still clear or block cookies via your browser settings. Most browsers allow per-site cookie controls.

sections.heading: Server logs
sections.body: Separate from cookies, our servers maintain short-lived (30-day) access logs containing anonymised IP, user agent and request path. These are used exclusively for security and operational monitoring.

sections.heading: Changes
sections.body: If our use of cookies changes, this page will be updated. The "Last updated" date above indicates the current version.

sections.body: Questions about cookies should be directed to contact@akieni.com.
